title: Church Holiness
definition: Church Holiness is the calling of Christ's people to be set apart from sin and devoted to God in doctrine, worship, conduct, and witness.
summary: Church Holiness is the congregation's corporate calling to be set apart for God in doctrine, worship, conduct, and witness.
christFocus: Jesus Christ cleanses His Church and presents her holy before Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the church's shared purity, not only individual morality. Christ sanctifies His people so the congregation reflects His truth and character. Corporate holiness includes sound doctrine, sexual purity, integrity, justice, worship, and separation from worldliness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because a church can preach holy words while tolerating unholy patterns. Corporate holiness protects witness and honors the Lord who dwells among His people. It also guards vulnerable members from the damage of tolerated sin.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask whether your church's culture helps people obey Christ or excuse compromise. Pursue holiness personally in ways that strengthen the whole body. Pray for leaders to address sin with courage and humility.
